title: Evidence: Canon EOS R5 Warranty Documentation
submitted_text:
High-resolution scan of purchase receipt from authorized retailer.
- Purchase date: March 15, 2023
- Retailer: Camera House NYC
- Item: Canon EOS R5 Body
- Serial: [matches camera]

Photo of included Canon warranty registration card.
Card shows standard 1-year manufacturer warranty.

Screenshot (claimed) of Canon product registration page.

I purchased this camera new from Camera House NYC in March 2023.
Canon's warranty lookup tool is known to have issues with recent registrations.
The buyer should try registering the camera themselves on Canon's website.
All my documentation is legitimate and I'm confident in the camera's authenticity.
